fields.name: PM-KISAN
fields.short_description: Financial support scheme for eligible farmer families.
fields.full_description: PM-KISAN provides financial support to eligible farmer families to help meet agricultural and household needs.
fields.benefits: Eligible farmer families receive financial assistance under the scheme.
fields.eligibility: Eligible farmer families who meet the scheme's applicable criteria can benefit from PM-KISAN.
fields.documents_required: Aadhaar number, bank account details, and land-related records as applicable.
fields.application_process: Eligible farmers can register through the official PM-KISAN portal or with assistance from the concerned government authorities.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

fields.name: MGNREGA
fields.short_description: Provides wage employment to rural households by offering guaranteed work opportunities.
fields.full_description: MGNREGA is a rural employment programme that provides wage employment to eligible rural households through public works.
fields.benefits: Provides wage employment and supports livelihood security for rural households.
fields.eligibility: Rural households whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work can seek employment under the scheme, subject to applicable rules.
fields.documents_required: Job Card and applicable identity and household details.
fields.application_process: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat or the concerned MGNREGA authorities and request employment.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development

fields.name: PMAY-G
fields.short_description: Provides financial assistance to eligible rural households for construction of a pucca house.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin provides assistance to eligible rural households to help them construct a safe and durable pucca house.
fields.benefits: Eligible rural households receive financial assistance for construction of a pucca house.
fields.eligibility: Eligible rural households identified according to the applicable government criteria can benefit from the scheme.
fields.documents_required: Aadhaar details, bank account details, and other documents as required by the concerned authorities.
fields.application_process: Eligible beneficiaries can approach the Gram Panchayat or concerned rural development authorities for information and assistance regarding the scheme.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development

fields.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
fields.short_description: A Maharashtra Government scheme that provides additional financial assistance to eligible PM-KISAN beneficiary farmer families.
fields.full_description: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana is a Maharashtra Government initiative introduced to provide additional financial assistance to eligible farmer families covered under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme. Under this scheme, the Maharashtra Government provides an additional ₹6,000 per year per eligible farmer family in three instalments.
fields.benefits: Eligible farmer families receive an additional ₹6,000 per year from the Maharashtra Government in three equal instalments.
fields.eligibility: Farmer families eligible under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme and registered on the PM-KISAN portal, subject to applicable government eligibility criteria.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
PM-KISAN registration details
Bank account details
Aadhaar-linked bank account details
Land/farmer records as applicable
fields.application_process: The beneficiary must be eligible under the PM-KISAN scheme and have the required registration and records. Eligible beneficiaries can use the Maharashtra Government's MahaDBT/official scheme services and relevant agriculture department services for scheme-related information and assistance.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
fields.short_description: A government crop insurance scheme that provides financial protection to farmers against crop losses caused by specified natural risks.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a crop insurance scheme of the Government of India. It aims to provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen events and to protect farmers from production risks.
fields.benefits:
Financial protection against covered crop losses.
Protection against production risks.
Helps stabilize farmers' income after eligible crop losses.
Encourages farmers to continue farming and adopt modern agricultural practices.
fields.eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and meeting the applicable PMFBY conditions can be covered under the scheme. Eligibility and coverage depend on the applicable state, crop and season notification.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity document
Bank account details
Land or cultivation records as applicable
Farmer and crop details
Mobile number
Other documents required under the applicable state/season notification
fields.application_process:
1. Check whether the crop and area are covered under the applicable PMFBY notification.
2. Register/login through the official PMFBY system or the applicable authorized channel.
3. Enter farmer, crop, land and bank details.
4. Complete the required insurance application and premium payment process.
5. Keep the application/policy details for future reference.
6. In case of eligible crop loss, report the loss through the prescribed process and track the claim status.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyaan (PM-KUSUM)
fields.short_description: A government scheme that supports farmers through solar power generation and solarisation of agricultural pumps.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyaan (PM-KUSUM) is a Government of India scheme implemented through designated state agencies. It supports decentralized solar power plants, standalone solar agricultural pumps and solarisation of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps.
fields.benefits:
• Supports solar agricultural pumps.
• Helps reduce dependence on diesel and conventional electricity for irrigation.
• Provides reliable daytime power for agricultural activities.
• Can help farmers reduce recurring energy costs.
• Under applicable components, farmers may earn income by selling surplus solar power to DISCOMs.
fields.eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), Water User Associations and other eligible beneficiaries may participate depending on the applicable PM-KUSUM component and state implementation rules.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Bank account details
Land documents, where applicable
Farmer and agricultural pump details
Mobile number
Other documents required by the State Implementing Agency
fields.application_process:
1. Check the applicable PM-KUSUM component and state notification.
2. Visit the official PM-KUSUM portal or the concerned State Implementing Agency.
3. Submit the required farmer, identity, land and pump details.
4. Complete verification and the required beneficiary contribution, where applicable.
5. After approval, the authorized agency/vendor carries out the applicable solar installation or solarisation work.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India

fields.name: Jal Jeevan Mission
fields.short_description: A Government of India mission that aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through functional tap water connections to rural households.
fields.full_description: Jal Jeevan Mission is a Government of India mission under the Ministry of Jal Shakti. It aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water to rural households through Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTCs). The mission also focuses on water source sustainability, water conservation, rainwater harvesting and greywater management.
fields.benefits:
• Provides functional tap water connections to rural households.
• Helps provide safe and adequate drinking water.
• Reduces the need to travel long distances to collect water.
• Supports better health and living conditions in rural communities.
• Promotes water conservation and source sustainability.
• Supports greywater management and rainwater harvesting.
fields.eligibility: The mission is intended for rural households and rural public institutions such as schools, Anganwadi centres, Gram Panchayat buildings and health centres. Implementation and coverage are carried out through States, Union Territories and local rural communities.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Address or household details
Mobile number
Bank account details, where required
Other documents as required by the concerned State or local authority
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the Gram Panchayat or concerned local water supply authority.
2. Check the availability and status of tap water connection in the village.
3. Submit the required household details and documents, if required.
4. The concerned authority verifies the household and water supply requirements.
5. After approval and implementation, the household receives a Functional Household Tap Connection.
6. Residents can contact the concerned local authority for water supply or service-related issues.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned State/UT water supply authority or Gram Panchayat for local service-related as

fields.name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin
fields.short_description: A Government of India mission focused on improving sanitation, cleanliness and waste management in rural areas.
fields.full_description: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G) is a Government of India mission focused on improving sanitation and cleanliness in rural areas. It aims to sustain open defecation free behaviour and promote safe management of solid and liquid waste in villages.
fields.benefits:
• Promotes cleanliness and hygiene in rural areas.
• Supports sustainable sanitation practices.
• Helps maintain Open Defecation Free (ODF) behaviour.
• Promotes solid and liquid waste management.
• Improves the overall quality of life in rural communities.
• Encourages community participation in sanitation activities.
fields.eligibility: Rural households, Gram Panchayats and rural communities can benefit from activities and facilities implemented under Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin. Specific assistance and eligibility depend on the applicable government guidelines and local implementation.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Address or household details
Bank account details, where applicable
Mobile number
Other documents required by the concerned Gram Panchayat or authority
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the concerned Gram Panchayat or local rural sanitation authority.
2. Check the available sanitation facilities or applicable assistance.
3. Submit the required household and personal details, if applicable.
4. The concerned authority verifies the information.
5. Eligible assistance or sanitation facilities are provided according to the applicable guidelines.
6. Contact the local authority for further information or status.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned Gram Panchayat or State/UT rural sanitation authority

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
fields.short_description: A Government of India scheme aimed at providing all-weather road connectivity to eligible rural habitations.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) is a Government of India rural roads programme under the Ministry of Rural Development. It aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected rural habitations and improve access to essential services and economic opportunities.
fields.benefits:
• Provides all-weather road connectivity to rural areas.
• Improves access to schools and healthcare facilities.
• Helps rural people access employment opportunities.
• Improves connectivity to markets and other essential services.
• Supports rural economic development.
• Improves the overall quality of life in rural communities.
fields.eligibility: Eligible unconnected rural habitations are covered according to the applicable PMGSY guidelines and rural road connectivity criteria. The actual selection and implementation are carried out through the concerned State Government and implementing agencies.
fields.documents_required:
Village / habitation details
Land and road-related records, where applicable
Survey and infrastructure details, where applicable
Other documents required by the concerned State Government or implementing agency
fields.application_process:
1. Rural habitations are identified according to PMGSY eligibility criteria.
2. The concerned State Government and implementing agency conduct the required survey and planning.
3. Eligible road connectivity proposals are prepared and approved according to PMGSY guidelines.
4. The road construction or upgradation work is carried out by the designated implementing agency.
5. Citizens can contact their Gram Panchayat or concerned rural roads authority for information about road connectivity and ongoing works.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

fields.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
fields.short_description: A Government of India mission that promotes sustainable livelihoods and self-employment opportunities for rural poor households through Self Help Groups and community institutions.
fields.full_description: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) is a Government of India mission under the Ministry of Rural Development. It aims to reduce rural poverty by organizing rural poor households, particularly women, into Self Help Groups and supporting them with financial services, skills, livelihoods and access to public services.
fields.benefits:
• Promotes Self Help Groups among rural women.
• Supports sustainable livelihood opportunities.
• Improves access to financial services and bank credit.
• Promotes self-employment and rural enterprises.
• Provides livelihood and skill development support.
• Helps rural households increase their income.
• Improves access to government and public services.
fields.eligibility: Rural poor households, particularly women, can participate through Self Help Groups and community institutions under DAY-NRLM. Specific eligibility and benefits are implemented according to the guidelines of the concerned State Rural Livelihoods Mission.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Address or household details
Bank account details
Mobile number
SHG-related details, where applicable
Other documents required by the concerned State Rural Livelihoods Mission
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the local Self Help Group, Gram Panchayat or State Rural Livelihoods Mission.
2. Join or form a Self Help Group according to the applicable guidelines.
3. Provide the required household and identity details.
4. Complete the required verification and SHG registration process.
5. Access available livelihood, financial, skill and enterprise support through the SHG and concerned rural livelihoods mission.
6. Contact the concerned State Rural Livelihoods Mission for further assistance.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned State Rural Livelihoods Mission (SRLM)

fields.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
fields.short_description: A Government of India skill development programme that provides training and employment opportunities to rural youth from poor families.
fields.full_description: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is a Government of India placement-linked skill development programme under the Ministry of Rural Development. It focuses on rural youth from poor families and provides industry-relevant skill training to improve their employability and access to regular employment.
fields.benefits:
• Provides skill development training to rural youth.
• Improves employability and job opportunities.
• Provides industry-linked training.
• Supports placement and regular employment.
• Helps rural families diversify their income.
• Gives priority to disadvantaged groups according to applicable guidelines.
fields.eligibility: Rural youth from poor families, generally in the age group of 15 to 35 years, can participate subject to the applicable DDU-GKY guidelines and State Rural Livelihood Mission requirements.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Age proof
Address or residence proof
Bank account details
Educational certificates, where applicable
Mobile number
Other documents required by the training centre or State Rural Livelihood Mission
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the official DDU-GKY portal or contact a nearby DDU-GKY training centre.
2. Register as a candidate and provide the required personal details.
3. Complete counselling and selection as per the applicable process.
4. Select a suitable skill training course.
5. Complete the required training and assessment.
6. Eligible candidates receive placement support after training.
7. Track training and placement information through the concerned programme authorities.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

fields.name: PM Vishwakarma
fields.short_description: A Government of India scheme that provides end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople for skill development, tools, credit and market opportunities.
fields.full_description: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme of the Government of India that supports traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools. The scheme provides recognition, skill training, toolkit support, collateral-free credit, incentives for digital transactions and marketing support.
fields.benefits:
• PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card.
• Basic and advanced skill training.
• Training stipend of ₹500 per day.
• Toolkit incentive of up to ₹15,000 through e-voucher.
• Collateral-free enterprise development loans up to ₹3 lakh.
• Concessional interest rate of 5%.
• Incentives for digital transactions.
• Marketing and branding support.
fields.eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in one of the 18 identified trades can apply, subject to the applicable PM Vishwakarma eligibility conditions.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Mobile number
Bank account details
Aadhaar-linked bank account details
Address details
Other documents required during verification
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the official PM Vishwakarma portal.
2. Apply through the prescribed registration process, generally with assistance from a Common Service Centre (CSC).
3. Provide Aadhaar and other required details.
4. Complete the required verification process.
5. After successful verification, receive PM Vishwakarma recognition.
6. Eligible beneficiaries can access skill training, toolkit incentive, credit support and other scheme benefits.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India

fields.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
fields.short_description: A Government of India programme that supports the establishment of new micro-enterprises and promotes self-employment and employment generation.
fields.full_description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy programme of the Government of India. It supports eligible individuals and other approved beneficiaries in setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and business/service activities. The programme aims to generate sustainable employment opportunities, particularly in rural and other areas.
fields.benefits:
• Supports setting up new micro-enterprises.
• Provides margin money subsidy as per applicable guidelines.
• Promotes self-employment and employment generation.
• Helps entrepreneurs obtain bank-financed project funding.
• Supports manufacturing and business/service activities.
• Encourages rural entrepreneurship and local employment.
fields.eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age can apply for assistance for setting up a new PMEGP enterprise, subject to the applicable scheme guidelines. There is no income ceiling for assistance for setting up projects under PMEGP.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
PAN Card
Address proof
Bank account details
Project report
Educational qualification certificate, where applicable
Category certificate, where applicable
Other documents required by the sponsoring agency or bank
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the official PMEGP e-Portal.
2. Register and submit the online application.
3. Provide personal, project and required document details.
4. Submit the project proposal for verification and appraisal.
5. The application is processed by the concerned implementing agency and bank.
6. After approval, the beneficiary completes the required formalities and training.
7. The bank provides the eligible project finance according to the applicable guidelines.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
fields.short_description: A Government of India scheme that provides LPG connections to eligible women from poor households to promote clean and safe cooking.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) is a Government of India scheme under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. It aims to provide clean cooking fuel through LPG connections to eligible women from poor households. The scheme helps households shift from traditional cooking fuels to LPG.
fields.benefits:
• Provides a deposit-free LPG connection to eligible beneficiaries.
• Covers applicable security deposit and installation-related charges.
• Provides LPG equipment as per the applicable scheme provisions.
• Supports clean and safer cooking.
• Reduces dependence on traditional cooking fuels.
• Helps improve the health and living conditions of rural households.
fields.eligibility: Adult women aged 18 years or above can apply for a PMUY connection, subject to applicable scheme conditions. The household should not already have an existing LPG connection, and the applicant must satisfy the required verification criteria.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Proof of Address
Ration Card / Family Composition Document, where applicable
Bank Account Details
Mobile Number
Passport-size Photograph
Other documents required during PMUY verification
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the official PMUY website or contact an authorised LPG distributor.
2. Select the PMUY application option.
3. Provide Aadhaar and other required personal and household details.
4. Submit the required documents and complete KYC/e-KYC.
5. The LPG distributor/OMC verifies the application and household details.
6. After successful verification, the eligible beneficiary receives the LPG connection and applicable benefits.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India

fields.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
fields.short_description: A Government of India health assurance scheme that provides cashless healthcare services to eligible beneficiaries at empanelled hospitals.
fields.full_description: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is a Government of India health assurance scheme that provides eligible families access to cashless and paperless hospitalisation services at empanelled healthcare providers.
fields.benefits:
• Provides cashless healthcare treatment to eligible beneficiaries.
• Provides coverage for eligible hospitalisation expenses.
• Beneficiaries can receive treatment at empanelled hospitals.
• Helps reduce the financial burden of major medical treatment.
• Provides an Ayushman card to verified beneficiaries.
fields.eligibility: Eligibility is based on the beneficiary database and applicable PM-JAY government criteria. Eligible families must complete the required beneficiary verification process to avail the scheme benefits.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity document
Ration Card / Family ID, where applicable
Mobile Number
Other documents required for beneficiary verification
fields.application_process:
1. Check your PM-JAY eligibility through the official portal or authorised centre.
2. Provide the required beneficiary and identity details.
3. Complete the beneficiary verification process.
4. After successful verification, obtain the Ayushman card.
5. Visit an empanelled hospital for eligible treatment.
6. Show the Ayushman card/beneficiary identification at the hospital.
7. Receive eligible treatment according to PM-JAY rules.
fields.implementing_department: National Health Authority, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
fields.short_description: A maternity benefit scheme that provides financial assistance to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) is a maternity benefit scheme under the Ministry of Women and Child Development. It provides financial support to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers to improve maternal and child health, nutrition and promote health-seeking behaviour.
fields.benefits:
• Provides ₹5,000 for the first living child in two instalments.
• Provides ₹6,000 in a single instalment if the second living child is a girl.
• Provides partial compensation for wage loss.
• Promotes proper health and nutrition of mother and child.
• Encourages antenatal check-ups and child immunization.
• Benefit is transferred directly through DBT to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
fields.eligibility: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers belonging to the prescribed categories under PMMVY can apply. Eligibility includes women from socially and economically disadvantaged groups, such as SC/ST women, BPL ration-card holders, e-Shram card holders, MGNREGA job-card holders, PM-JAY beneficiaries and women with family income below ₹8 lakh per year, subject to applicable guidelines.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card
Aadhaar-linked bank account details
Mobile number
Mother and Child Protection Card
Pregnancy registration details
Antenatal Check-up details
Child birth registration certificate
Child vaccination details
Ration Card / eligibility document, where applicable
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the official PMMVY portal or contact the nearest Anganwadi Worker/ASHA Worker.
2. Register the pregnancy and provide the required personal details.
3. Submit the required documents and complete verification.
4. Complete the prescribed antenatal check-ups.
5. Register the child's birth and complete the required immunization.
6. After approval, the eligible benefit is transferred through DBT.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the nearest Anganwadi Worker / ASHA Worker or PMMVY authorities

fields.name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
fields.short_description: A Government of India programme focused on the survival, protection, education and empowerment of the girl child.
fields.full_description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) is a Government of India programme focused on creating awareness and promoting social and behavioural change for the safety, protection, education and development of the girl child. It encourages communities and different stakeholders to value the girl child and improve opportunities for girls.
fields.benefits:
• Promotes the value and dignity of the girl child.
• Supports education and development of girls.
• Helps address gender-biased sex selection.
• Promotes awareness about the safety and protection of girls.
• Encourages higher enrolment of girls in secondary education.
• Helps reduce school dropout among girls.
• Promotes awareness about menstrual hygiene.
fields.eligibility: The programme focuses on girl children, adolescents, families, communities and other stakeholders. It is implemented through awareness, community participation and multi-sectoral interventions rather than individual cash benefits.
fields.documents_required: No individual application documents are generally required because Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is an awareness and social change programme and does not provide individual cash benefits.
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the concerned District Administration, Women and Child Development Department or local authorities.
2. Participate in awareness and community activities related to girl child education, protection and empowerment.
3. For education or other specific government benefits, apply through the concerned department or applicable scheme.
4. Contact the local authorities for information about BBBP activities in your district.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India

fields.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
fields.short_description: A safe motherhood scheme that promotes institutional delivery among eligible pregnant women and provides financial assistance.
fields.full_description: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) is a centrally sponsored scheme under the National Health Mission. It aims to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality by promoting institutional delivery among eligible pregnant women. The scheme combines cash assistance with delivery and post-delivery care.
fields.benefits:
• Provides financial assistance to eligible pregnant women.
• Encourages delivery in government health institutions.
• Promotes safe motherhood and institutional delivery.
• Helps reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.
• Provides assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), where applicable.
• Supports antenatal and postnatal care through health workers.
fields.eligibility: Eligible pregnant women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families and eligible Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) women can apply according to the applicable state and national guidelines. Eligibility may depend on the place of delivery and the type of health institution.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Mother and Child Protection Card
Ration Card / BPL certificate, where applicable
SC/ST certificate, where applicable
Bank passbook or bank account details
RCH number, where applicable
Mobile number
fields.application_process:
1. Register the pregnancy at the nearest government health centre.
2. Contact the ANM, ASHA worker or concerned health worker.
3. Submit the required documents and beneficiary details.
4. Complete the required antenatal check-ups and registration.
5. Deliver at an eligible government or accredited health institution.
6. After verification, the eligible financial benefit is transferred through DBT.
7. Contact the nearest health centre for application or payment status.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
fields.short_description: A national financial inclusion scheme that provides access to basic banking services to people who do not have a bank account.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a National Mission for Financial Inclusion of the Government of India. It aims to provide affordable access to basic savings bank accounts, credit, remittance, insurance and pension services, especially to weaker sections and low-income groups.
fields.benefits:
• Provides a basic savings bank account.
• No minimum balance is required.
• Provides a RuPay debit card to eligible account holders.
• Provides applicable accident insurance cover with the RuPay card.
• Eligible account holders can get overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.
• Enables Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
• Provides access to insurance and pension schemes.
• Helps improve financial inclusion in rural and low-income communities.
fields.eligibility: Any person who does not have a bank account can open a basic savings bank deposit account under PMJDY, subject to applicable banking and scheme requirements.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity document
Address proof, where required
Mobile number
Other officially accepted KYC documents, where applicable
fields.application_process:
1. Visit the nearest bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet.
2. Ask for a PMJDY account opening form.
3. Provide the required KYC documents and personal details.
4. Complete the account opening and verification process.
5. After successful verification, the basic savings account is opened.
6. Eligible account holders receive the applicable RuPay debit card and can access other linked financial services.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India

fields.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
fields.short_description: A credit scheme that provides timely and affordable credit support to farmers for agriculture and allied activities.
fields.full_description: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) is a Government of India credit scheme that provides farmers with timely and adequate credit for crop cultivation, purchase of agricultural inputs, post-harvest expenses and other agriculture and allied activities.
fields.benefits:
• Provides timely credit support to farmers.
• Helps farmers purchase seeds, fertilizers and other agricultural inputs.
• Supports crop production and post-harvest expenses.
• Provides working capital for agriculture and allied activities.
• KCC facilities are also available for eligible animal husbandry and fisheries activities.
• Provides flexible withdrawal and repayment facilities.
• Interest benefits are available according to applicable government guidelines.
fields.eligibility:
Individual or joint owner cultivators
Tenant farmers
Oral lessees and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
Eligible farmers involved in animal husbandry and fisheries activities
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity proof
Address proof
Land ownership or cultivation documents, where applicable
Bank account details
Passport-size photograph
Agriculture / crop details
Other documents required by the lending bank
fields.application_process:
1. Visit a participating bank, Regional Rural Bank, Cooperative Bank or eligible lending institution.
2. Obtain and complete the KCC application form.
3. Submit the required identity, land and agriculture-related documents.
4. The bank verifies the applicant and assesses the credit requirement.
5. After approval, the Kisan Credit Card and sanctioned credit facility are provided.
6. The farmer can use the facility for eligible agricultural and allied activities.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned bank or lending institution

fields.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
fields.short_description: A Government of India savings scheme designed to encourage savings for the education and future of a girl child.
fields.full_description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a Government of India small savings scheme for the benefit of a girl child. A natural or legal guardian can open an account in the name of a girl child below 10 years of age. The scheme encourages long-term savings for the girl's education and future financial needs.
fields.benefits:
• Encourages long-term savings for a girl child.
• Account can be opened for a girl below 10 years of age.
• Minimum annual deposit is ₹250.
• Maximum annual deposit is ₹1,50,000.
• Account matures after 21 years from the date of opening.
• Partial withdrawal is allowed subject to applicable conditions.
• Provides tax benefits under applicable income-tax rules.
• Government-backed savings scheme.
fields.eligibility: A girl child below 10 years of age is eligible for an account. The account can be opened by her natural or legal guardian. Generally, one account can be opened in the name of each girl child, subject to the applicable scheme rules.
fields.documents_required:
Girl child's birth certificate
Aadhaar Card / valid identity document
Guardian's identity proof
Guardian's address proof
Passport-size photographs
Other KYC documents required by the Post Office or authorised bank
fields.application_process:
1. Visit a Post Office or authorised bank.
2. Obtain the Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form.
3. Submit the girl's birth certificate and required KYC documents.
4. Complete the account opening process with the guardian's details.
5. Make the required initial deposit.
6. Continue making deposits according to the applicable scheme rules.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

fields.name: PM SHRI Schools
fields.short_description: A Government of India initiative to develop selected schools into model schools with quality education, modern infrastructure and improved learning facilities.
fields.full_description: PM SHRI Schools (PM Schools for Rising India) is a Government of India initiative to develop selected existing schools as exemplar schools. The initiative focuses on providing high-quality education, modern infrastructure, a safe and engaging learning environment, and improved learning outcomes for students.
fields.benefits:
• Improved school infrastructure and learning facilities.
• Better teaching and learning environment.
• Modern laboratories, libraries and digital learning facilities.
• Focus on competency-based and experiential learning.
• Development of green and sustainable school facilities.
• Improved learning outcomes and holistic development of students.
fields.eligibility: Students studying in selected PM SHRI Schools are the beneficiaries of the initiative. Schools are selected according to the applicable PM SHRI scheme guidelines and eligibility criteria.
fields.documents_required: Student identification documents, school admission/records and other documents required by the concerned school or education authority.
fields.application_process:
1. Find out whether a PM SHRI School is available in your area.
2. Contact the concerned school or local education authority.
3. Follow the school's admission process.
4. Submit the required student documents.
5. Complete the admission and verification process according to school rules.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Education, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned PM SHRI School or local education authority.

fields.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
fields.short_description: A scholarship scheme that provides financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to help them continue their education.
fields.full_description: The National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) is a scholarship scheme of the Government of India. It aims to encourage meritorious students from economically weaker sections to continue their studies at the secondary and higher secondary levels and reduce school dropouts.
fields.benefits:
• Provides financial assistance to eligible students.
• Encourages students to continue their education.
• Helps reduce school dropouts.
• Supports meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
• Scholarship support is provided from Class 9 to Class 12, subject to applicable rules.
fields.eligibility: Students studying in eligible schools who meet the prescribed academic and parental income criteria under the NMMSS guidelines. Students are generally selected through the prescribed state-level selection process.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / valid identity document
Income Certificate
School/Student ID
Bank Account Details
Academic/School Records
Caste Certificate, if applicable
Disability Certificate, if applicable
fields.application_process:
1. Check the NMMSS eligibility criteria.
2. Apply through the prescribed scholarship application process.
3. Complete the required student and school details.
4. Submit the necessary documents.
5. Appear for the prescribed selection examination, where applicable.
6. Complete verification by the concerned authorities.
7. Eligible students receive the scholarship through the prescribed payment process.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Education, Government of India

fields.name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)
fields.short_description: A government education initiative that provides residential schooling facilities to girls from disadvantaged groups in educationally backward areas.
fields.full_description: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) is an educational initiative under Samagra Shiksha that aims to provide residential schooling facilities to girls from disadvantaged groups in educationally backward areas. The programme helps girls who may face difficulties in accessing or continuing formal education, particularly in rural and underserved areas. It focuses on providing a safe learning environment, improving access to quality education, reducing school dropouts and encouraging girls to continue their education.
fields.benefits:
• Residential schooling facilities
• Better access to education for girls
• Support for girls from disadvantaged communities
• Helps reduce school dropout
• Supports continuation of education
• Safe learning and residential environment
fields.eligibility: Girls from disadvantaged groups studying in eligible educationally backward areas, according to applicable Samagra Shiksha guidelines.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar Card / Identity Proof
Birth Certificate
School Records
Address Proof
Caste Certificate, if applicable
Income Certificate, if applicable
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the nearest KGBV or local education authority.
2. Check eligibility and available seats.
3. Submit the required documents.
4. Complete the verification process.
5. Follow the admission procedure of the concerned KGBV.
fields.implementing_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India

fields.name: Samagra Shiksha
fields.short_description: An integrated Government of India scheme supporting school education, quality improvement, infrastructure, digital learning and equitable access to education.
fields.full_description: Samagra Shiksha is an integrated Government of India scheme for school education covering pre-school to senior secondary level. It aims to improve the quality of education and provide equitable access to learning opportunities for children across the country, including students in rural and educationally disadvantaged areas. The scheme supports school infrastructure, digital learning, teacher training, girls' education, inclusive education, vocational education and other interventions that contribute to the holistic development of students and improvement of learning outcomes.
fields.benefits:
• Support for school infrastructure
• Digital learning facilities
• ICT labs and smart classrooms
• Teacher training and academic support
• Support for girls' education
• Support for children with special needs
• Vocational education
• Focus on educationally backward areas
fields.eligibility:
• Support for school infrastructure
• Digital learning facilities
• ICT labs and smart classrooms
• Teacher training and academic support
• Support for girls' education
• Support for children with special needs
• Vocational education
• Focus on educationally backward areas
fields.documents_required:
Student/School identification documents
School records
Aadhaar/Identity Proof where applicable
Other documents required by the concerned school or education authority
fields.application_process:
1. Contact the concerned government school or education authority.
2. Check the facilities and support available under Samagra Shiksha.
3. Submit required documents where applicable.
4. Complete the school-level admission or benefit process.
5. Follow the instructions of the concerned education department.
fields.implementing_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
fields.helpline: Contact the concerned State/UT Education Department or school.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
fields.short_description: A Government of India programme that provides free and assured antenatal care to pregnant women on the 9th of every month.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) is a Government of India programme launched by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. It aims to provide assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care free of cost to pregnant women on the 9th of every month. The programme provides a minimum package of antenatal care services at designated government health facilities, with special attention to women in the 2nd and 3rd trimesters and identification of high-risk pregnancies.
fields.benefits:
Free antenatal care services for pregnant women.
Quality pregnancy check-ups at designated government health facilities.
Minimum package of investigations and medicines.
Special focus on identification of high-risk pregnancies.
Counselling and pregnancy-related health guidance.
One ultrasound during the 2nd trimester as part of the minimum investigation package, subject to programme guidelines.
Mother and Child Protection Card and safe motherhood booklet.
Services are provided on the 9th of every month.
fields.eligibility: All pregnant women are eligible to receive PMSMA antenatal care services at designated government health facilities. Special attention is given to women in the 2nd and 3rd trimesters, women who have missed or not received antenatal care, and high-risk pregnant women.
fields.documents_required:
Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card, if available.
Antenatal care or previous medical records, if available.
Pregnancy-related test reports, if available.
Any government identification document, if required by the health facility..
fields.application_process:
Visit a designated government health facility providing PMSMA services on the 9th of the month.
Register at the PMSMA/antenatal care clinic.
Undergo the advised antenatal check-up, investigations and counselling.
Receive medicines, supplements and other services as prescribed.
Women identified as high-risk are advised for further care and follow-up at appropriate government health facilities.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India

fields.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission
fields.short_description: A Government of India mission that aims to build an integrated digital health ecosystem and enable secure access and exchange of health information.
fields.full_description: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) is a flagship initiative of the Government of India aimed at creating an integrated and interoperable digital health ecosystem. It connects citizens, healthcare professionals, health facilities and digital health services through common digital building blocks. The mission enables citizens to create an Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA), access and manage digital health records, and share health information securely with consent.
fields.benefits:
Creation of an ABHA number for digital health identity.
Access and management of personal health records digitally.
Linking health records generated at different healthcare facilities.
Consent-based sharing of health records with verified healthcare providers.
Verified information about hospitals, clinics and healthcare facilities.
Online search and booking of healthcare appointments through interoperable digital services.
Easy access to verified healthcare professionals.
Paperless and more convenient digital healthcare services.
fields.eligibility: Citizens can voluntarily create and use an Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) and participate in the ABDM digital health ecosystem, subject to applicable identity verification and service requirements.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar card or another valid KYC document for ABHA creation.
Mobile number.
Basic identity and demographic details as required for verification.
fields.application_process:
Visit an official ABDM/ABHA service or supported healthcare platform.
Choose the option to create an ABHA.
Complete identity verification using Aadhaar or another supported KYC document.
Enter the required details and create the ABHA number and ABHA address.
Use the ABHA to access and manage digital health records through supported applications and healthcare services.
fields.implementing_department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
fields.short_description: A Government of India housing scheme that provides assistance to eligible rural households for constructing pucca houses with basic amenities.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) is a Government of India scheme aimed at providing pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households living in inadequate or kutcha houses. The scheme focuses on improving housing conditions and supporting poor and vulnerable rural families to achieve better living standards.
fields.benefits:
Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house.
Support for eligible rural households without adequate housing.
Improved housing conditions and living standards.
Convergence with other government programmes for basic amenities, subject to applicable guidelines.
Support for poor and vulnerable rural families.
fields.eligibility: Eligible rural households that are houseless or living in inadequate/kutcha houses, as identified through the prescribed government process and applicable PMAY-G guidelines.
fields.documents_required:
Aadhaar card or valid identity document.
Bank account details.
Address/residence details.
Proof of household or beneficiary details as required.
Other documents required during official verification.
fields.application_process:
Check eligibility through the prescribed PMAY-G government process.
Contact the Gram Panchayat or concerned rural development authority.
Submit the required beneficiary details and documents.
The application and eligibility are verified by the concerned authorities.
After approval, assistance is released as per applicable government rules and construction stages.
fields.implementing_department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
fields.short_description: A Government of India accident insurance scheme providing financial protection against accidental death and disability.
fields.full_description: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is a one-year personal accident insurance scheme of the Government of India, renewable every year. It provides insurance coverage against accidental death and specified permanent disabilities for eligible bank and Post Office account holders.
fields.benefits:
Accidental death: ₹2 lakh.
Permanent total disability due to accident: ₹2 lakh.
Permanent partial disability due to accident: ₹1 lakh.
Annual premium: ₹20 per member.
Premium is normally collected through auto-debit from the participating bank or Post Office account.
fields.eligibility: Individual account holders of participating banks or Post Offices between 18 and 70 years of age are eligible to join the scheme, subject to applicable scheme rules. A person can enrol through only one bank or Post Office account even if they have multiple accounts.
fields.documents_required:
Bank or Post Office account details.
Aadhaar or other KYC details as required.
Mobile/contact details.
Nominee details.
Consent-cum-declaration form for enrolment.
fields.application_process:
Contact a participating bank or Post Office.
Submit the PMSBY consent-cum-declaration/enrolment form.
Provide the required account and KYC details.
Give consent for annual premium auto-debit.
After enrolment and successful premium deduction, the accident insurance cover becomes effective as per the scheme rules.
fields.implementing_department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
